column1: # zu_gold.tsv — Zulu epitran zul-Latn REFEREE set (NOT oracle/gold). epitran is an
# independent programmatic G2P that corroborates our L2S but is FALLIBLE: it drops ejectives, writes bare
# clicks (ǀ vs our kǀ), ng→ŋ (not ŋɡ), and ⟨kl⟩ as k+l (not the kx affricate). NB epitran DOES palatalise
# the homorganic nasal (nj→ɲd͡ʒ) — epitran was RIGHT and ours had the gap (now fixed; convergence Run 2).
# The word set is the CURATED zu_tone.tsv lexicon (real Zulu words — no corpus/English contamination).
# nguni-gold-eval.ts folds the documented epitran limitations; our committed GOLD is the integration test.
